shade.title: {name} (shade {index} of {count})
shade.description: Where is this shade's bottom edge (hemline) when fully open and when fully closed? Measure every shade from the same point, such as inches from the floor.

shade_prefilled.title: {name} (shade {index} of {count})
shade_prefilled.description:
Where is this shade's bottom edge (hemline) when fully open and when fully closed? Measure every shade from the same point, such as inches from the floor.

Prefilled from the previous shade.

travel.title: Travel time
travel.description:
How long does {name}, the tallest shade, take to go from fully closed to fully open?

All shades are assumed to move at the same speed.

roller_curve.name: Roller curve correction
roller_curve.description:
Most roller shade positions count motor turns, not distance. The roll is fattest when open, so the hemline drops faster near the top, and 50% sits above the halfway point. Set {name} to 50% and enter its hemline height.

The shades' rolls are assumed to match: same fabric and tube, and equally full when the hemlines are level.

data_description.halfway_height: Between {low} and {high}. Leave empty if your hemlines move at a constant speed.

controls.title: Picos and scenes
controls.description: A Pico or Lutron scene starts several shades with one command, so they start at exactly the same moment. When some of the group's shades start level, the group uses any Pico or scene covering just those shades, and commands the rest itself.{controls}

add_pico.title: Add a Pico
add_pico.description: A shade Pico (with a middle button) paired on the Caseta bridge. Its On, Stop and Off buttons are disabled in Home Assistant by default, so enable them on the Pico's device page first.

data_description.device_id: Its On, Stop and Off buttons are found automatically.

add_scene.title: Add a scene
add_scene.description: A Lutron scene that moves some of these shades, all to the same position. Use only a scene that moves nothing else: activating it moves everything in it.

error.closed_not_below_open: The closed height must be below the open height.
error.cover_unsupported: Every shade must support setting a position and stopping.
error.ranges_do_not_overlap: This shade's open-to-closed range doesn't overlap the other shades'. Every shade's range must share some height.
error.halfway_out_of_range: That's outside the heights a roller shade can have at 50%; check the measurement and the open and closed heights.
error.halfway_cant_reach: This 50% height can't fit every shade on one roll curve, so your shades' rolls probably don't match. Leave it empty to align them as if every shade moved in a straight line, or check the measurements.
error.pico_not_a_shade_pico: That device doesn't have On, Stop and Off buttons. Choose a shade Pico with a middle button.
error.pico_buttons_disabled: Enable the Pico's On, Stop and Off buttons on its device page first (Home Assistant disables them by default).
error.control_shades_not_in_group: Choose only shades in this group.

abort.reconfigure_successful: Saved. The group has been reloaded with its new settings.

entities_missing.title: {name} can't find some of its devices
entities_missing.description:
These were renamed, removed or disabled:

{entities}

Until this is fixed, {name} leaves out missing shades, and moves its shades one by one if its Pico's buttons are missing.

To fix this, open {name} under Settings → Devices & services → Aligned Shade Group, choose Reconfigure from its menu, and choose its shades and Pico again.
